run_update_version: run the script with a version string like 3.7.1 to update all protobuf version files
run_update_version_rc: run the script with a version and RC number like 3.7.1 2 to set a beta release version
review_GetFullVersion: review the GetFullVersion function that returns the version string with optional RC suffix
review_RewriteXml: review the RewriteXml function that parses an XML file, applies a rewriter callback, and writes it back
review_RewriteTextFile: review the RewriteTextFile function that reads a text file line by line and applies a line rewriter callback
